summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Alpha Tau Medical Ltd., a foreign private issuer, announcing its first quarter 2026 financial results and corporate update. The press release covers clinical trial updates (REGAIN, ReSTART, IMPACT, ACAPELLA), FDA and PMDA regulatory progress, and cash position. There are no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation elements. The filing is an ordinary earnings and operational update, not a special situation.
